title: Final Radius
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct radius of the ground state for positronium as a0' = 2 a0.

title: Final Binding Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct binding energy of the ground state for positronium as E1' ≈ 6.8 eV.

title: Energy Level Diagram
description: Important Criteria: The student should include a clear and accurate energy level diagram illustrating the dependence on the magnetic field.

title: Spin-Spin Interaction
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the effect of spin-spin interaction on the energy levels of positronium.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Optional Criteria: The student may describe the perturbation Hamiltonian used in the analysis of positronium in a magnetic field.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the reduced mass or sign mistakes in energy calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations and explanations.
